script: Did Vini Jr ever ACTUALLY consider leaving Madrid, or was Arsenal completely played? Back in January of 2025, Real Madrid sat down with their star winger Vinicius Junior to offer him a new contract, and Vini Jr said no. Then he said no again. For eighteen months, Madrid kept improving the deal while Vini Jr kept turning it down, because he felt he deserved to be paid like one of the best players on the planet. But there was one club watching those rejections closely, waiting for the exact moment to strike. Arsenal had just won the Premier League, so they felt bold enough to chase a Madrid Galactico, entering talks with his camp and reportedly matching his wage demands. Spanish outlet AS even said some Arsenal players considered the transfer a done deal. Then Vini Jr wiped his entire Instagram history, an account with almost sixty-four million followers that suddenly showed zero posts, which is usually the sign of a player packing his bags. But the timing of that blackout is the part that tells you what was really going on. Within days, Madrid put a fresh offer on the table worth £18.5M a year, and new Madrid boss Jose Mourinho made it clear he wanted Vini as a key player, which helped pull him back in. Hours ago, Vini Jr signed a brand new six year contract keeping him at the Bernabeu until 2032. So did he ever truly consider leaving? Not really. Arsenal's interest was genuine, yet they were only ever the pressure that got Vini Jr the massive raise he wanted all along.
